answer: Escrow bonds with a referral graph stop bulk fake identities. An agent locks a bond of twice its 30-day earnings in a vault for 20 epochs and names its referrer, so lineage is visible in a garden. Peers may dispute a cluster; if confirmed, the bond is slashed and the referrer fined. Honest agents pay once and keep undiluted rewards. Minting 100 fakes costs 100 bonds, 200 months of earnings, while a lantern of open data exposes the cluster first.
